items.title: Junior Mance Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995…
items.q: Miles Davis made the statement once he says, “Man I don’t like Oscar Peterson.” I say, “Why?”

ctx.x: And it’s chamber music. It may as well be written down.

Exactly. Yeah. Because you know, it’s funny, Miles Davis made the statement once he says, “Man I don’t like Oscar Peterson.” I say, “Why?” He says, “Because he never makes a mistake.” Which Oscar doesn’t. Oscar is flawless when he plays all the time. But Miles, you know Miles made a lot of mistakes, so did Bird. But to us, we figure it was supposed to be like that. It’s like Steve Martin when he stumbles and falls, oh I meant to do that. Like you remember, there’s a record that’s really a classic, one Bird made,…
Some people even will say that you come up with your best ideas when you paint yourself into a corner.
